entities.summary: Enrico Coveri was a performers & entertainers in Prato (1952-02-26, Prato – 1990-12-07) who made significant contributions during the Contemporary era. Their work intersected with economic development and trade and geopolitical linkage and diplomacy. Influenced economic patterns and commercial practices.
